title: The Narrow Corridor of Stable Solutions in an Extended Osipov--Lanchester Model with Constant Total Population
abstract: arXiv:2512.18515v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper studies a modification of the classical Osipov-Lanchester model in which the total population of the two sides, $N=R+B$, stays constant. In this model the ratio $y=R/B$ obeys the Riccati equation $\dot y=\alpha y^2-\beta$, which is solvable in elementary functions for all values of the parameters. The main result is a complete classification of the stable regimes. An asymptotically stable invariant set in the quadrant $R,B\ge 0$ exists only in three cases: $\alpha<0,\ \beta<0$ gives a stable interior equilibrium; $\alpha=0,\ \beta<0$ makes the boundary $B=0$ stable; $\alpha<0,\ \beta=0$ makes the boundary $R=0$ stable. If $\alpha>0$ or $\beta>0$, every solution except one unstable equilibrium reaches a boundary of the quadrant in finite time, where the model stops being applicable. translated_title: 总人口恒定的扩展Osipov–Lanchester模型中稳定解的狭窄走廊
translated_abstract: 本文研究了经典Osipov–Lanchester模型的一个修正版本，其中双方的种群总数 N=R+B 保持恒定。在该模型中，比值 y=R/B 服从里卡蒂方程 ẏ=αy²−β，该方程对所有参数取值均可用初等函数求解。主要结果是对稳定状态的完整分类：在象限 R,B≥0 内，渐近稳定的不变集仅在三种情形下存在——α<0 且 β<0 时存在稳定的内部平衡点；α=0 且 β<0 时边界 B=0 稳定；α<0 且 β=0 时边界 R=0 稳定。当 α>0 或 β>0 时，除一个不稳定平衡点外，所有解都会在有限时间内到达象限的边界，此时模型不再适用。当参数随时间变化时，若 α(t) 与 β(t) 遵循缓冲动力学，则系统可保持与边界的固定距离。
tldr: 本文完整分类了总人口恒定的扩展Osipov–Lanchester模型的稳定状态，证明稳定解仅存在于参数空间的一条狭窄走廊中，一旦参数超出该范围，所有轨迹都将在有限时间内到达模型失效的边界。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a complete classification of stable regimes in an extended Osipov–Lanchester model with constant total population, showing that stable solutions exist only within a narrow corridor of the parameter space, outside which every trajectory reaches an infeasible boundary in finite time.
